A DRAIN_TRANSFER offset alone cannot establish lossless pipe transfer: define the reader freeze barrier, asyncio-buffer/in-flight chunk transfer, durable spool positions, acknowledgment and failure ownership. Descriptor identity checks are not an OFD/lock/wait-ownership proof. All non-terminal rows retain origin and UNKNOWN holds. No descriptor/row cap may replace genuine large-roster cases.
seam_evaluations.title: Other-LIVE resource custody

seam_evaluations.dependencies: Seams 1,3,5,7,8,9 and SL-0. The slice list omits seam-7 cost/interface dependencies. Lab demonstrations are operator-gated.

Option A is not selected by this review: tying all new independent requests to the first root's amount/kind may refuse requests the original host/ledger domain accepts. Parent_Supports requires equal charge kind; different grants, owners, costs, larger later requests and rollovers need a full-domain accounting design. Do not borrow the first root grant or invent a coordinator cost. UNKNOWN has no known current owner to forward to; identify a protected recovery authority and actual original owner guards for every phase. Preserve the original quarantine.resolve exception rather than silently widening all owner routes. Removing gather-under-lock alone does not prove availability: synchronous filesystem/native/SQLite work and queue fairness remain obligations.
seam_evaluations.title: Live request multiplexing

Preserve Parent_Supports, Original_Holds, equal/different workloads, optional world facts, actor credentials and original stdin/EOF. Kernel nesting/clone support are unmeasured. Helper source can be drafted; privileged delegation and real actor quota require operator action.

Define a canonical comparable value and independently authenticated record for each pair: endpoint object versus pathname, full handler plan versus observed argv/exe, root RUNNING versus scoped RECORD_RUNNING are not inherently identical encodings. OB-030 requires distinct source tags or source-record hashing enforced by native Decide/Well_Formed and a copied-tag negative, not sourcing alone. Expected helper image and actual coordinator executable must retain their distinct meanings. Preserve full dynamic operation/owner/follow-up plans and D1/D2 cost correspondence. Ceilings at or below the reservation are insufficient for OB-176's real enforced capacity/availability guarantee; retain original minimum/low/weight accounting and host-pressure requirements. No static cost table may narrow original magnitudes or cases.
seam_evaluations.title: Cost/source crosswalk

seam_evaluations.dependencies: Seams 3,4,7,9, exact-type caller audit and OS-producer historical lineage. Actual relative PID/exited-peer behavior needs authorized lab observation.
seam_evaluations.finding: Receive the full roster first and keep raw relative versus retained host credentials distinct. CrosswalkRequestPeer can be an additive exact type, but observation() returning the old document must be labeled retained and must not satisfy a fresh-kernel gate by renaming. fstat equality alone does not prove OFD identity, transport origin or the peer/request join. Preserve UID/GID and preparer/same-UID-new-process domains. Neither missing a fresh pidfd after client exit nor a new live-process requirement may replace an originally accepted request; obtain/retain original kernel observations under custody and define unavailable evidence honestly. seam_evaluations.title: Requester PID-namespace join

seam_evaluations.finding: Native ownership transition legality is required, not optional, because it gates mutation. Replace the printed (CUSTODY_ACK|ABANDON)->WORKER_OWNED chain with exclusive branches: ABANDON never grants worker ownership. Define the transfer generation, per-request head, durable expected phase and actual pre-/post-commit observations under one CAS; protect the last capture through close/receive and resolve lost local or remote acknowledgments without a second mutation. Physical closure must remain collectible when handler/result records are absent. Keep EOF/deadline/missing cgroup as UNKNOWN, with no release/charge. Escrow reuse and cleanup-after-CLOSED are sound directions. Lossless content addressing needs an acyclic reconstruction scheme and a defined source snapshot closure; distinct full-state snapshots can still grow or recursively contain earlier captures, so deduplication alone is not an OOM remedy or storage/cost proof. Unknown canonical result must not erase an independently durable committed broker result.

Pin semantics and exact full-source identity are separate: proof_manifest cannot carry its own exact content hash in CONTRACT_PINS without a hash cycle, and the existing normalizer is Ada-oriented even for Python/C. Bind manifest, controls, projects, headers, native helper and the dependency overlays through an external exact inventory/freeze. Do not broaden the Off boundary or treat C hardening/sanitizers as full-body proof. Add the native custody, delegation, tagged-source and crosswalk units to ordered enrollment. Resolve the frontier retirement contradiction with I10.3 and retain all required controls on their defined domains.
